integrity: The neighborhood-table checker is included and executes without external dependencies. Finite computations corroborate, rather than establish, the infinite recurrence. All new file bytes are SHA-256 protected.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for the four-column cylindrical strong product of a path and the four-cycle; equivalences are nonequivariant, though the specified fixed-point homeomorphism is exact. Independent verification and exhaustive exclusion of implicit prior results are not claimed.
title: Cylindrical four-column king complexes: a sphere-wedge recurrence and sharp Smith equality
